13775.d: The Hoop and stick is a Ranged activity in the games room of a player-owned house.
13775.ex: You can try to get a hoop over this.

13776.d: A hooved mage is encountered during the Nadir Fremennik Sagas.
13776.ex:
(Nadir: Before fight)
• This creature is strange to me. It seems to be a powerful mage, of sorts.
(Nadir: During fight)
• My disguise is nothing to this creature. It must die - quickly.

13777.d: Hope devourer is a Dungeoneering boss monster that can be fought on the Warped floors of Daemonheim, beginning at floor 51.
13777.ex: A dark behemoth that feeds on hope.

13783.d: Hops is an alcoholic assistant to the Chemist who can be found outside the Chemist's House in Rimmington or in the Dancing Donkey Inn in Varrock alongside Chancy and Da Vinci.

13785.d: Hops Patches are a type of Farming patches which require 4 seeds (or 3 for jute seeds) to plant, starting at level 3 Farming.
13785.ex: You can grow hops in this Farming patch.

13786.d: Horacio Dobson is the gardener to Lord Kurt Handelmort.
13786.ex: Could do with losing a few pounds.

13787.d: Horgon is a young Dorgeshuun cave goblin found in Dorgesh-Kaan's nursery complex, under the care of Mernik.

13788.d: The Horn of Glory is a large horn used in the Barbarian Assault minigame.

13789.d: Horned graahks are creatures resembling large, spiked boars that can be caught at level 41 Hunter.
13789.ex: Get in a graahk's way and you're going to know about it... however briefly.

13790.d: The horrific crassian is a mini-boss encountered during the Temple of Aminishi elite dungeon in the third room, where four Cloaked zealots are found in a supposed ritual area.
13790.ex: As if the regular overgrown crustaceans weren't horrific enough.
